title: Regional Amazon API Gateway with edge-optimized domain name to AWS Lambda
description: Create a regional API with edge-optimized domain name and a Lambda integration.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys an Amazon API Gateway REST regional API with an edge-optimized domain name and a Lambda integration.
You will need: a route53 hosted zone, an ACM Certificate in the us-east-1 region.
The domain name choosen needs to match or be a subdomain of the domain name on the certificate.

bullets.text: Routing traffic to an Amazon API Gateway API by using your domain name
Creating an edge-optimized custom domain name

text: 1. Enter the ARN of the certificate (which is in us-east-1) and the custom domain name in the parameters of the template.
2. Create a new record in your Hosted zone in route53 with an alias to the API Edge-Optimized endpoint
3. Paste the custom domain name into a browser to make requests
